status: proposed supplemental metadata; original trace.json unchanged
evidence_class: source-audited checkpoint-forward interpretation; not physics or control validation

root_channel0.semantic: predicted target root height above contact ground

root_channels1_2.semantic: raw auxiliary outputs; no direct world-horizontal displacement or velocity target in active loss
root_channels1_2.training: indirectly constrained by active decode-reencode latent consistency

nonroot_channels.semantic: raw auxiliary position-head outputs; no direct XYZ supervision under fk_loss=true
nonroot_channels.training: indirectly constrained by active decode-reencode latent consistency

hpos.noteworthy_unused_computation: train_dual.py computes rw_target-rw_source and yaw trigonometry at lines 443-445, but neither enters root loss at lines 451-452.
hpos.gradient_scope_caveat: Auxiliary channels are not untrained: active re-encoding consistency supplies an indirect gradient path.

rotation_fk.semantic: target-root-relative FK from predicted global rotations and fresh official H2 offsets
rotation_fk.interpretation: Metric kinematic visualization output, distinct from raw hpos.

attention.interpretation: Per-head softmax recomputed from actual forward-captured inputs and trained projection weights; module-output parity checked.
attention.probability_axis: last dimension; each query row sums to 1
attention.source: Q,K,V = projections of block-pre-normalized source tokens; learned hop bias enters logits.
attention.rotation_pool: Q=projection of LN(learned queries); K,V=projections of LN(final encoder output).
attention.target_decoder_layer0: Q=projection of LN(official H2 descriptor); K,V=projections of LN(post-FSQ reconstructed rotation tokens).
attention.normalization_note: Pre-LN means normalization BEFORE Q/K/V projection; captured projection inputs are normalized.

scope_limits: Three independent single-frame forwards, not temporal generation.
Source clip is a training-domain demonstration, not held-out or zero-shot evidence.
Official H2 query differs from the legacy H2 anonymous training tree.
Predicted free global rotations and their FK positions are not hardware qpos and have not undergone control, IK, or dynamics validation.
Non-root hpos vectors and root-specific hpos vector have different supervision semantics; use FK for skeleton visualization.
Other robot cards are alternative embodiments, not concatenated simultaneous inputs.

58:     def quantize(self, z):
59:         # z: [...,f] unbounded -> bounded to [-1,1]-ish then to level grid
60:         half = (self._levels - 1) / 2
61:         # bound with tanh scaled so range covers the levels
62:         zt = torch.tanh(z) * half
63:         zr = torch.round(zt)

67:         # 让解码器对 ±1 格抖动平滑 (相邻帧码位跳格 -> 脚点不跳)。eval 时不加, 码本不变。
68:         if self.training and getattr(self, "noise", 0.0) > 0:
69:             zq = zq + (torch.rand_like(zq) - 0.5) * (2 * self.noise)
70:         # normalize to [-1,1] for the decoder
71:         return zq / half

213: class GraphBiasAttention(nn.Module):
214:     """MHA with additive per-head bias from clamped hop distance."""
215:     def __init__(self, d_model, n_heads, max_hop=16):
216:         super().__init__()
217:         self.h = n_heads; self.dk = d_model // n_heads
218:         self.q = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model); self.k = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model)
219:         self.v = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model); self.o = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model)
220:         self.hop_emb = nn.Embedding(max_hop + 2, n_heads)  # +1 pad/unreachable bucket
221:         self.max_hop = max_hop
222: 
223:     def forward(self, x, hop, key_padding_mask=None):
224:         B, J, D = x.shape
225:         q = self.q(x).view(B, J, self.h, self.dk).transpose(1, 2)
226:         k = self.k(x).view(B, J, self.h, self.dk).transpose(1, 2)
227:         v = self.v(x).view(B, J, self.h, self.dk).transpose(1, 2)
228:         att = (q @ k.transpose(-1, -2)) / (self.dk ** 0.5)  # [B,h,J,J]
229:         hb = hop.clamp(max=self.max_hop + 1)               # [B,J,J]
230:         bias = self.hop_emb(hb).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)         # [B,h,J,J]
231:         att = att + bias
232:         if key_padding_mask is not None:
233:             att = att.masked_fill(key_padding_mask[:, None, None, :], float("-inf"))
234:         att = att.softmax(-1)
235:         out = (att @ v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, J, D)
236:         return self.o(out)
237: 
238: 
239: class EncBlock(nn.Module):
240:     def __init__(self, d, h):
241:         super().__init__()
242:         self.a = GraphBiasAttention(d, h); self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
243:         self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, 4 * d), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(4 * d, d))
244:         self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
245: 
246:     def forward(self, x, hop, kpm):
247:         x = x + self.a(self.n1(x), hop, kpm)
248:         x = x + self.ff(self.n2(x))
249:         return x
250: 
251: 
252: class CrossBlock(nn.Module):
253:     def __init__(self, d, h):
254:         super().__init__()
255:         self.mha = nn.MultiheadAttention(d, h, batch_first=True)
256:         self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(d); self.nq = nn.LayerNorm(d)
257:         self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, 4 * d), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(4 * d, d))
258:         self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
259: 
260:     def forward(self, q, kv, key_padding_mask=None):
261:         a, _ = self.mha(self.nq(q), self.n1(kv), self.n1(kv), key_padding_mask=key_padding_mask)
262:         q = q + a
263:         q = q + self.ff(self.n2(q))
264:         return q
